caption: The drawing depicts three human figures standing side by side beneath a decorative, temple-like structure with a triangular pediment colored in red, yellow, green, and black. The figure on the left is an adult male wearing a red top, a yellow skirt with red polka dots, grey overlays, and a reddish-brown hat, holding a black staff in his left hand and the hand of the middle figure with his right. The figure on the right is an adult female dressed in a long red dress with green trim, black shoes, and short dark hair, holding the hand of the middle figure with her left hand while her right hand is placed on her chest. The center figure is a smaller person in a red dress, with a yellow crown or spikes around their head and short brown hair. This central figure stands slightly in front of the other two, holding both of their hands. The background features a geometric pattern with a large, white diamond shape outlined in red and decorated with green dots. To the left, the wall is shaded with earthy tones and to the right, there is a yellow section with a red, wavy vertical stripe. The entire scene is enclosed within a rectangular frame with straight and slightly curved lines. The number “28” is drawn in the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 28: The Holy Family: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
